She proved lucky when she was announced as the winner, successfully surpassing 52 other contestants after being selected among the final seven finalists in the competition. Gelvia Vanessa received a trophy, RM15,000 in cash and various prizes presented by Toh Puan Faridah Tussin, wife of the Yang di-Pertua Negeri of Sabah, witnessed by Datin Seri Julia Salag, the Chief Minister’s wife, and Datin Seri Linda Ewit, wife of the Deputy Chief Minister I.
